item.title: [LOW] Microsoft 365 Android Apps Let Any App Steal Account Tokens via Leftover Debug Flag
item.description: A development flag left switched on in production builds of several Microsoft 365 Android apps disabled the check that limits account-token sharing to trusted Microsoft apps. No password, no login screen, no permission prompt.
